title: Each stage on fresh material
statement: Run the worked example, the guided practice and the independent task on different material, so no stage answers another and the last one tests transfer, not rehearsal.
detail: The lesson-components spec sets independent practice on a different, later passage than the worked example used, and the lesson designs check it in their soundness sweeps: one runs the same procedure on a different section of a story, with fresh evidence, and a science lesson models on one section and re-runs the procedure on another. A rebuilt lesson placed its added guided station in a third setting so that it pre-answers neither the model nor the independent task, and its walkthrough gives the reason: repeating on the same evidence is rehearsal, and new evidence is transfer. A history lesson adds that independent practice is released only once the worked model and its completed analysis are taken away.
against: The spec is a design: its package says it does not establish runtime verification, student readiness or evidence of learning outcomes (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/course-packages/courses/apush/review/evidence/case-for-review.md`).
